DDInter1600.mechanism: Riociguat may potentiate the action of antihypertensive agents and other vasodilators. Symptomatic hypotension may occur. Inhibition of glucose and sodium co-transport produces mild diuresis and transient natriuresis, resulting in intravascular volume contraction.
